hero.headline: Ensuring a Secure Compute Community
hero.subheadline: We use a streamlined verification process to protect our infrastructure from malicious use and maintain compliance with international laws.

sections.title: Protecting our Infrastructure and our Clients
sections.body: Due to the extreme power of our GPU and CPU clusters, Kenya AI Compute adheres to strict 'Know Your Customer' (KYC) and 'Know Your Business' (KYB) protocols. This isn't just about compliance with Kenyan and international anti-money laundering (AML) laws; it's about the physical safety of our facility and the integrity of our network. By verifying our users, we ensure that our high-density resources are used for legitimate AI research, 3D rendering, and decentralized compute tasks. This process prevents our IPs from being blacklisted and ensures that our SLA remain stable for all legitimate users. We have automated this process to ensure that for most individuals and companies, verification takes less than 15 minutes, allowing you to launch your clusters without unnecessary delay. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models. sections.title: Verification Requirements
items: Individual: Valid government-issued ID and a liveness check.
Business: Certificate of incorporation and proof of operational address.
Compute Purpose: A brief description of your intended use case (e.g., 'LLM training').
Payment Verification: Linking a valid payment method or verified wallet.
Sanctions Screening: Automated checks against international restricted lists.
